fields.name: site
fields.label: Site
fields.schema_description: Site containing the network devices to validate.

options.notes: From useEnvData (useEnvData.ts:34-41). The UI value is 'dcim-location:["<location_type>","<id>"]' when the row has location_type, otherwise the bare id (location-options.ts:21-36). location_type is a repeated static query param. The colliding-id case is covered by siteCableValidationForm.spec.ts:53-77.

fields.query_param_normalization: Resolved against loaded locations by encoded value, provider id, or display name; unresolvable resolves to '' (site-cable-validation-workflow-form.tsx:110-115). The Nautobot link passes the location display name (views.py:210,264). The query is re-applied on env-data change until the user edits any field.
client_only_validation: Trimmed min 1 'Site is required' (:42); the schema has no minLength
fields.submit_transform: The encoded option is decoded: site = option id, or the raw form value if no option matches. The option's location type is emitted as site_type (:144-147).

fields.name: roles
fields.label: Roles
fields.schema_description: Device roles used to filter the selected network devices.
fields.query_param_normalization: Multi-value (getAll('role'), singular name). Values not matching a loaded option key are dropped; if none remain the field becomes [] (:72-83, :116).

fields.name: status
fields.label: Device Status
fields.schema_description: Device statuses used to filter the selected network devices.
fields.query_param_normalization: Multi-value (getAll('status')). Values not matching a loaded option key are dropped; if none remain the field falls back to ['Active', 'Provisioned'] (:117-123).
client_only_validation: At least one item: 'Device Status is required' (:47-50)

fields.name: tenant
fields.label: Tenant
fields.schema_description: Tenant used to filter the selected network devices.
fields.query_param_normalization: Single value. Maps a matching option key to its value, otherwise '' (setSingleQueryValue :60-69, :124-129). The Nautobot link always includes 'tenant=' (empty when the device has no tenant) with the tenant name (views.py:207,261).
fields.submit_transform: '' becomes undefined, so the key is omitted (tenant: data.tenant || undefined, :150).

fields.name: site_type
fields.schema_description: DCIM location type for the site identifier.
fields.widget_today: none (derived from the selected site option)
fields.submit_transform: location.locationType of the resolved site option (:147). The key is omitted when undefined.

fields.name: device_type_ids
fields.schema_description: Device type identifiers used to filter network devices.
fields.submit_transform: Always sent as [] ('Hardcode these values, not relevant to end users', :151-153).

fields.name: raise_for_invalid
fields.schema_description: Whether invalid cabling should fail the workflow.

payload_transform: onSubmit (site-cable-validation-workflow-form.tsx:142-168) resolves the selected site option and builds {site: option?.id ?? data.site, site_type: option?.locationType, roles, status, tenant: data.tenant || undefined, device_type_ids: [], raise_for_invalid: false}. JSON.stringify drops undefined keys (site_type for bare-id options, tenant when empty) and the body is POSTed to /v1/workflow/ngc/site_cable_validation. Every spec payload assertion includes device_type_ids: [] and raise_for_invalid: false (siteCableValidationForm.spec.ts:150-157, 224-231, 322-333).
discrepancies: The UI requires site to be non-empty. Unlike SiteBackupInput, the schema site has no minLength; LocationReference rejects empty values only during API reference resolution (workflow_references.py:52-56, workflow_submission.py:158-161).
The UI requires at least one status; the schema allows an empty list.
device_type_ids and raise_for_invalid are never rendered but are always sent explicitly, with values equal to the schema defaults.
The Nautobot link passes device-id, which this form never reads.

The Nautobot link interpolates site and tenant without |urlencode (configmanagerdevicestatus_workflows_tab.html:92), unlike the configdiff link at :61. Names containing '&', '#' or spaces depend on browser tolerance.

No Playwright test exercises the exact Nautobot URL shape (site name + device-id + empty or non-empty tenant). The URL-param tests use site/role/status/tenant (siteCableValidationForm.spec.ts:99-163).
The roles field is pre-filled from the singular query param 'role'.
Label 'Device Status' differs from schema title 'Status'.
contract_gaps: Hidden constant fields (device_type_ids: [], raise_for_invalid: false) must still be submitted for byte-identical parity. There is no hidden hint, and the contract does not say whether initial_values for unrendered fields are submitted.
site_type is a sibling filled from the selected site option's location_type, and the contract has no mechanism for that (the server convention is '<field>_type', workflow_submission.py:163).
The location option source needs the repeated static param location_type=Site&location_type=Module, but OptionSource.params is scalar-only.
The status min-1 rule and non-empty site are enforced only on the client.
query_param is an allowlist; there is no way to declare a known-but-ignored Nautobot param (device-id). This is harmless if unknown params are ignored.
